# idempotency

## README

# Idempotency

Same request, same result — dedupe on request ID.

## What it shows

- `requestId` prevents duplicate inserts and returns the cached result
- Custom write handler that owns business defaults

## Source

Feature entry point: `src/feature.ts`.

## Tests

Needs the Postgres from the repo root's `docker-compose.yml` (`docker compose up -d`); `TEST_DATABASE_URL` defaults to `postgresql://kumiko:kumiko@localhost:15432/kumiko_test`.

```bash
cd samples/recipes/idempotency
bun test
```

### src/__tests__/feature.integration.test.ts

```ts
// Idempotency Sample — Integration Test
// Proves: duplicate requestId returns cached result, no double insert

import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import type { SaveContext } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { createTestUser } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/seeding";
import { setupTestStack, type TestStack } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack";
import { orderFeature } from "../feature";

let stack: TestStack;

const customer = createTestUser({ roles: ["Customer"] });

beforeAll(async () => {
  stack = await setupTestStack({ features: [orderFeature] });
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await stack.cleanup();
});

beforeEach(() => {
  stack.events.reset();
});

describe("idempotent writes", () => {
  test("same requestId returns cached result, no duplicate", async () => {
    const requestId = "order-idem-001";

    const first = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "orders:write:order:place",
      { customerName: "Alice", product: "Widget" },
      customer,
      requestId,
    );

    const second = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "orders:write:order:place",
      { customerName: "Alice", product: "Widget" },
      customer,
      requestId,
    );

    // Same ID = cached, not a new record
    expect(second.id).toBe(first.id);
  });

  test("different requestIds create separate records", async () => {
    const first = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "orders:write:order:place",
      { customerName: "Bob", product: "Gadget A" },
      customer,
      "order-a",
    );

    const second = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "orders:write:order:place",
      { customerName: "Bob", product: "Gadget B" },
      customer,
      "order-b",
    );

    expect(first.id).not.toBe(second.id);
  });

  test("no requestId = always creates new record", async () => {
    const first = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "orders:write:order:place",
      { customerName: "Carol", product: "Same" },
      customer,
    );

    const second = await stack.http.writeOk<SaveContext>(
      "orders:write:order:place",
      { customerName: "Carol", product: "Same" },
      customer,
    );

    expect(first.id).not.toBe(second.id);
  });
});
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
// Idempotency Sample
// Shows: requestId prevents duplicate inserts, returns cached result.
// Custom `order:place` handler so we can inject a default status — a generic
// `order:create` would not know about the business rule "new orders start as
// pending".

import { buildEntityTable, createEventStoreExecutor } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/db";
import { createEntity, createTextField, defineFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { z } from "zod";

export const orderEntity = createEntity({
  name: "order",
  table: "read_sample_orders",
  fields: {
    customerName: createTextField({ personal: { of: "id" }, find: "none", required: true }),
    product: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data", required: true }),
    status: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data", default: "pending" }),
  },
});

const orderTable = buildEntityTable(orderEntity);
export const orderFeature = defineFeature("orders", (r) => {
  r.entity(orderEntity);

  const orderExecutor = createEventStoreExecutor(orderTable, orderEntity, { entityName: "order" });

  r.writeHandler({
    name: "order:place",
    schema: z.object({
      customerName: z.string().min(1),
      product: z.string().min(1),
    }),
    handler: async (event, ctx) =>
      orderExecutor.create({ ...event.payload, status: "pending" }, event.user, ctx.db),
    access: { roles: ["Admin", "Customer"] },
  });

  r.queryHandler({
    name: "order:list",
    schema: z.object({ limit: z.number().optional() }),
    handler: async (query, ctx) => orderExecutor.list(query.payload, query.user, ctx.db),
    access: {
      openToAll: {
        reason:
          "any signed-in user may list orders in this recipe; placing an order still requires a role above",
      },
    },
  });
});
```
